name: dye-whorl
title: Dye Whorl
description: Full-bleed animated background: a real GPU fluid simulation of ink diffusing in water - billowing plumes, tendrils, drops landing every few seconds - and the pointer stirs it. Monochrome ink that follows the theme (dark ink on light, light ink on dark). Children render on top.
darkMode: automatic: reads --background, --foreground, --border, --muted-foreground (or --ns-muted) from <html>, any colour format, and re-reads when the .dark class changes. Optional --ns-accent tints freshly stirred ink.
mainProps: children (content over the tank), speed, density (0..2), stir (0..2), paused, className (give it a height, e.g. h-screen), style
notes: WebGL2 + half-float required; without it renders just --background behind the children. Pauses off-screen / hidden tab; reduced-motion shows a still, developed frame. Auto-lowers quality on slow devices. Heavy on GPU - one per page. The 21st.dev prompt was truncated at 50k chars: pointer events, run/pause wiring, theme observer, cleanup and JSX were rewritten for GreficLib; the solver and shaders are original.
